name: Aurlandsdalen valley
why: Down 'the Grand Canyon of Norway', from Østerbø past waterfalls, old summer farms and a path cut in the cliff to Vassbygdi near Aurland.
book: Free: the Norwegian right to roam (allemannsretten). Paid parking at the trailhead. Bus from Aurland to Østerbø in summer.
dangers: Narrow cliff path with chains in places.

points.name: Østerbø
points.note: A mountain lodge at the head of the valley.

points.name: Sinjarheim
points.note: An old farm high on a ledge of the canyon.

points.name: Vassbygdi
points.note: A hamlet by a lake at the bottom of the valley.
